jobs.title: Telecommunications Engineer / Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description: Company Description Oil & Gas Careers GCC is a specialized platform focused on sharing verified walk-in interview opportunities in Dubai within the energy and related sectors. The page is dedicated to ensuring that job seekers access accurate, up-to-date information about legitimate hiring events. By prioritizing verification, the platform helps candidates avoid misleading or unconfirmed postings. This targeted approach supports both employers and professionals seeking efficient, trustworthy recruitment channels in the Gulf region. Role Description The Owner role at Oil & Gas Careers GCC is a part-time hybrid position based in Masqaţ, Oman, with flexibility for some work-from-home activities. The Owner oversees the daily operations of the platform, including sourcing, vetting, and posting verified walk-in interview opportunities in Dubai. This role involves maintaining relationships with employers and recruiting firms, monitoring industry trends, and ensuring that all shared information meets quality and verification standards. The Owner also manages content updates across social and digital channels, responds to inquiries from job seekers and partners, and tracks engagement metrics to improve reach and impact. Additional responsibilities include developing simple growth strategies, coordinating any freelance or partner contributions, and safeguarding the integrity and reputation of the platform. Qualifications Experience managing online platforms or social media pages, with the ability to curate and publish accurate, timely content. Strong organizational and time-management skills to handle part-time responsibilities alongside verification and posting tasks. Ability to research, verify, and validate job postings and employer information using reliable sources and professional judgment. Effective written and verbal communication skills in English for interacting with employers, partners, and job seekers. Familiarity with the Gulf job market, especially Dubai and the oil and gas or related sectors, is highly beneficial. Comfort working in a hybrid environment from Masqaţ, Oman, including remote coordination and digital collaboration. Basic understanding of digital marketing or audience engagement strategies to grow reach and maintain user trust. Prior experience in recruitment, career services, or community management is an advantage, though not mandatory.
